title: GrASP Pattern v1
description: A Greedy Augmented Sequential Pattern: an interpretable, ranked, multilayer pattern indicative of a target phenomenon (claim/evidence/argumentation/compliance/policy-trigger). Each position is a feature SET drawn from several augmentation layers; gaps are allowed within a window; patterns may target the negative class. A GrASP match emits source-record.v1 mentions and supplies the human-readable feature_contributions consumed by edge-witness / resolution-decision.

pattern_class.description: GrASP can learn patterns for the negative class, not only positive.

window.description: Max span (in tokens) within which the feature sets must match; gaps are allowed inside it.

feature_sets.description: Ordered positions. Each position is a SET of layer attributes that must all hold for one token (cross-layer generalization within a word).

value.description: Layer value, e.g. pos=NN, named_entity=Person, syntactic_relation=@obj, lexicon='<express:v:2', topic=TOPIC.

info_gain.description: Correlation with the label (drives top-K selection).

emits.description: Binding: how a match projects into the identity spine.

mention_entity_class.description: entity_class stamped on the emitted source-record mention.

edge_witness_feature.description: feature name contributed to an EdgeWitness/ResolutionDecision explanation.
